resources.string: Keeps Quick Settings and the power menu locked.
Quick Settings and the power menu are blocked whenever your phone is locked.
Enable NoLockQS in Vector for System UI and System Framework, then reboot.
Swipes from the status bar are blocked, so toggles like Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and airplane mode stay out of reach.
Holding the power button can\'t open it. Needs System Framework in Vector\'s scope.
If NoLockQS keeps your phone safer, you can support its development on Patreon.
No browser found to open the link.
Works on rooted Pixel phones running Android 15 or newer.
No data collected. Everything runs on your device.
